تصطلحوا (form VIII)
# تَصْطَلِحُوا (taṣṭaliḥū) /tasˤ.tˤa.li.ħuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَلَحَ (iṣṭalaḥa)
# تُصْطَلَحُوا (tuṣṭalaḥū) /tusˤ.tˤa.la.ħuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَلَحَ (iṣṭalaḥa)
